summary: Fortress Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of Class I shares for $7.5 million (309,338 shares at $24.2066, equal to July 31, 2026 NAV) under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D to accredited investors. It also declared an August distribution of $0.1834/share, paying September 22, 2026. Portfolio commentary noted $1.9 billion fair value across 91 companies, 98.2% first lien, 99.9% floating rate. This is a routine capital raise and distribution disclosure for a BDC; no special-situations event, premium, advisory, or strategic action. Watch for quarterly NAV updates only.
